interpretation: This is a controlled HFoV simulation, not a physical multi-phone capture with ground-truth intrinsics.
A solver success without an inlier/uncertainty gate is not a reliable focal estimate.
The wide-FoV 120-degree case is especially unstable under finite-FoV rendering and sparse correspondences.
The current clip does not justify replacing the raw production path with one fixed virtual-camera FOV.

recommended_deployment.primary: Estimate calibration from image geometry only: use GeoCalib/vanishing-point initialization, then unknown-focal P4Pf/P5Pfr RANSAC and aggregate focal across a short session.
recommended_deployment.validation: Accept a focal estimate only when multi-frame median/dispersion, reprojection error, inlier count, and trajectory consistency pass gates.
recommended_deployment.temporal_refinement: Refine K, per-frame pose, and optionally local 3D structure from tracked multi-frame geometry with bundle adjustment.
recommended_deployment.fallback: Keep raw localization as the first path; try estimated-K/virtual-camera hypotheses only when confidence is low. Use multi-FoV or 360-degree map coverage for cameras whose FoV has little overlap with the map.
